shapeSummary: Simplified single assembled track unit: a 180 x 60 mm stadium-shaped track loop (3 mm wall, 20 mm wide) with two 55 mm discs standing in for the sprocket and idler, each on a 3 mm x 60 mm axle along Y. The Y range is 0 to 60, and X and Z are centered on 0. The sprues, loose parts, screws and shafts of the kit photo are not modeled.
warnings: The source is a kit of loose parts on sprues, not a single solid. The model is a rough assembled-unit approximation.
Dimensions are unverified and estimated from the supplied bounds (180 x 60 x 60 mm).
Track link teeth, sprocket teeth, wheel spokes and recesses, wheel caps, the hex shaft and the tapping screws are omitted.
The 3 mm hole at the part center from the analysis was not cut, because the axles are modeled solid at the wheel centers (x=±60).
The track width (20 mm) and wheel size (55 mm) are guesses.
cadquery:
tw=20
y0=20
ring=(cq.Workplane('XZ',origin=(0,y0,0)).slot2D(180,60).extrude(-tw)
    .cut(cq.Workplane('XZ',origin=(0,y0,0)).slot2D(174,54).extrude(-tw)))
part=ring
for x in (-60,60):
    wheel=cq.Workplane('XZ',origin=(x,y0+2,0)).circle(27.5).extrude(-(tw-4))
    axle=cq.Workplane('XZ',origin=(x,0,0)).circle(1.5).extrude(-60)
    part=part.union(wheel).union(axle)
